avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces amitriptyline levels; serotonergic activity increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort or use alternative antidepressant; allow 2-week washout before switching

avoid_supplements.name: Linezolid
avoid_supplements.mechanism: MAOI-like activity combined with amitriptyline's serotonergic effects increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative antibiotic if possible

avoid_supplements.name: SAM-e
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonergic activity increases risk of serotonin syndrome and excessive CNS effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent supplementation; counsel patient on serotonin syndrome symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive stimulant effects and mild serotonergic activity
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased agitation, tremor, or tachycardia; consider dose adjustment if needed

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression may increase sedation and dizziness
caution_supplements.action: Advise patient to monitor for excessive drowsiness; take at separate times if possible

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo Biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Minor serotonergic activity; theoretical increased bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation or serotonergic symptoms; assess bleeding risk if on concurrent anticoagulants

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Although amitriptyline has weak MAOI activity, high tyramine intake may increase hypertension risk
avoid_foods.action: Limit excessive intake of aged cheeses, cured meats, and heavily fermented foods; monitor blood pressure

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression increases sedation, impaired cognition, and motor coordination
caution_foods.action: Advise patient to limit or avoid alcohol; counsel on increased fall and accident risk

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP1A2 interaction may increase amitriptyline levels; stimulant effects may antagonize sedation or cause jitteriness
caution_foods.action: Monitor for tremor, tachycardia, or anxiety; reduce caffeine intake if adverse effects occur

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase amitriptyline plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Advise patient to avoid grapefruit juice or consume consistently; monitor for increased anticholinergic or CNS effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, high blood pressure, dilated pupils, muscle rigidity), anticholinergic toxicity (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, confusion), and excessive CNS depression. Assess CYP2D6 phenotype if available, as poor metabolizers may experience elevated amitriptyline levels and increased adverse effects.
